info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Human Resource Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Workforce Contracts Management API provides mechanisms to update workforce contracts within the HR management system. This API allows organizations to adjust contract parameters dynamically, enabling them to accommodate changes in workforce needs and compliance requirements. Typical consumers of this API include HR managers and software developers integrating human resource functionalities into their applications. The API supports targeted updates using unique identifiers, ensuring precision and efficiency in contract management.

patch.summary: Update workforce contract details for a specific employee.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific workforce contract associated with employee EMP-900045. It is designed for HR management to modify contract terms, conditions, or other relevant information as required.

requestBody.description: This request is used to update the details of the workforce contract identified by the specified employee ID (EMP-900045). Ensure that the data provided in the request body adheres to the defined schema for successful updates.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the resource has been updated.
